information_gain: Construct a state-price certificate covering arbitrary nonnegative mixed and unequal YES/NO quantities, rather than merely retaining the existing eighteen basis rows.
outcome_known_before_freeze: The existing source screen rejected all eighteen rows; this is post-hoc mathematical strengthening, not new validation or repricing.

population.ordering: all markets, ascending numeric market ID

law: One exhaustive mutually exclusive winner. YES_i pays 1 only in i; NO_i pays 1 in every state except i. Supplied costs are nonnegative, linear and in the same unit.
prices: Preserve direct bestAsk YES and one-minus-bestBid NO proxies from the exact retained response. Strictly outside (0,1) or missing sides stay unavailable. No fee, tick or old-row recalculation.
certificate: Find exact nonnegative weights summing to one, with w_i <= YES_i and 1-w_i <= NO_i for every available side. Failure produces a strictly profitable supplied-law cover; preserve contradiction without escalation.
cost_limit: Certificate concerns the supplied gross vector. Additional nonnegative costs cannot create a nominal floor surplus. Nonlinear costs, rebates, funding and execution are not qualified.
consequences: Preserve original result and missing sides. No refetch, sibling, repair, book, fee endpoint, account, order, on-chain, model, training or protected capture follows from either outcome.
